syntax-regression.cause: A return is replaced with a break outside any loop.
syntax-regression.consequence: CPython reports SyntaxError and cannot load the module.
syntax-regression.impact: The module is unusable, regardless of whether callers reach the changed function.

unchanged-consumer.cause: fetch_items returns an empty list instead of None; the unchanged consumer only guards None.
unchanged-consumer.trigger: Call first_item() when fetch_items has no items.
unchanged-consumer.consequence: first_item indexes the empty list and raises IndexError instead of returning 'missing'.
unchanged-consumer.impact: The consumer loses its normal empty-state behavior.

ranges.text:

    if items is None:
